synthesis: The Clarity 'Manage Your Subscription' page lists per-tier feature bullets under an active 'Included Features' list and a greyed-out 'Coming Soon' list. Several Coming-Soon items have actually shipped and two labels are wrong. Update the hardcoded feature arrays in the Blade view so Pro Lite and Clarity Pro reflect reality: promote/rename shipped features into the active lists, remove the now-empty Pro Lite Coming Soon section, and add one deployed feature (Optimized Gridding (Scout)) that is missing from Clarity Pro.

scope.summary: Pure marketing-copy edit to one Blade view. Feature bullets are literal strings in @foreach arrays; move/rename/add entries. No PHP logic, no data, no billing behavior changes.

proposed_changes.reason: AC1 + AC2 — both features shipped; promote into active list. AC2 also renames from 'Advanced Gridding Analytics'.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC1: Pro Lite — 'Advanced Plate State recognition' moved from Coming Soon to the active included-features list.
AC2: Pro Lite — 'Advanced Gridding Analytics' renamed to 'Advanced Kit User Path' and moved to the active list.
AC3: Pro Lite — the Coming Soon section is removed entirely (empty after the two promotions).
AC4: Clarity Pro — 'RDN custom reports' renamed to 'RDN Reporting Integration' and moved to the active list.
AC5: Clarity Pro — 'Optimized Gridding (Scout)' added as a new active-features entry.

questions.q: AC1 label casing: ticket writes 'Advanced Plate State Recognition' (capital R); existing code string is 'Advanced Plate State recognition' (lowercase r). Item 1 says 'promote', not 'rename'.
questions.answer: Preserve the existing string 'Advanced Plate State recognition' verbatim — item 1 requested a move, not a rename, so making no unrequested label change is the conservative default.

notes: Feature lists are hardcoded literal-string @foreach arrays — no enum/config/DB source of truth to keep in sync.
Both the Pro Lite and Clarity Pro cards render unconditionally in the grid regardless of the viewer's currentTier, so a single pro-admin render test can assert all changed strings.
'Advanced Kit User Path' is distinct from the pre-existing 'Kit User Path' bullet in the Basic tier — no collision.
No ClickHouse / migration / auth / billing-logic surface; the page mount only reads org Pro-tier meta from Postgres.

tests.what_it_pins: Rendered page shows the new active labels ('Advanced Plate State recognition', 'Advanced Kit User Path', 'RDN Reporting Integration', 'Optimized Gridding (Scout)') and no longer shows the removed/renamed labels ('Advanced Gridding Analytics', 'RDN custom reports').

key_files: app/Filament/Pages/Subscription.php (Page class; mount() sets currentTier from org meta)
grounding.code_flow: Subscription Page::mount() loads currentTier from org Pro-tier meta and renders subscription.blade.php. Feature bullets are static @foreach arrays in the view; no dynamic feature source.

exhaustiveness.conclusion: The three labels being changed appear ONLY in subscription.blade.php. No upsell/source-feature, enum, or config sibling occurrences. Change is fully contained in one view + its test.

plan_sketch.intent: As a Pro Lite org, open Manage Subscription; confirm the two features are in the active list and Pro Lite has no Coming Soon section.
As a Clarity Pro org, confirm 'RDN Reporting Integration' and 'Optimized Gridding (Scout)' are in the active list and 'RDN custom reports' is gone from Coming Soon.
Render the page and assert the label strings present/absent.

qa_hint.seed_scenario: A Pro admin user whose org can be flipped between pro_lite and clarity_pro tiers (via platform_repo_pro_tier meta) — the createUser(pro:true) factory + meta update already used throughout SubscriptionTest.

escalate.reason: Single self-contained Blade view; every change explicitly specified in the ticket; exhaustiveness sweep confirms no siblings; no data/auth/migration/CH surface; no material open questions.
